name: TrimTailor Widget
author: trimtailor

sections.description:
This plugin enables seamless integration of the TrimTailor appointment widget on your WordPress website.

Simply enter your Company ID and the plugin automatically loads the TrimTailor widget script on every public page of your site. Visitors can then book, modify, or cancel appointments through the TrimTailor widget.

Your Company ID can be found inside TrimTailor under /settings/widget.

All widget styling, services and appointment options are managed directly inside your TrimTailor account. This plugin only handles loading the widget on your WordPress site.

External services

This plugin relies on the external TrimTailor service to provide the appointment booking widget.

What service is used and why?

The plugin loads an external script from the TrimTailor widget service:

https://widget.trimtailor.com/

This script is required to display the online appointment booking widget on your website and to connect it with your TrimTailor account.

What data is sent and when?

When the widget script is loaded, the following information is sent to TrimTailor:

  • Your TrimTailor Company ID (configured in the plugin settings).
  • Standard technical information sent by the visitor’s browser when loading external resources (such as IP address, browser type, operating system, and the URL of the page where the widget is embedded).

When a visitor uses the widget to book, modify, or cancel an appointment, the following additional data may be sent to TrimTailor (depending on how your TrimTailor account is configured):

  • Contact details such as name, email address, and phone number.
  • Appointment details such as selected service(s), staff member, date and time.
  • Optional information related to the pet/grooming service (for example: pet name, breed, notes), as configured in your TrimTailor account.

All processing of this data is performed by TrimTailor and requires an active TrimTailor subscription.

Terms of use and privacy policy

For more information about how TrimTailor processes data, please refer to:

  • TrimTailor Terms of Use: https://trimtailor.com/terms-of-use
  • TrimTailor Privacy Policy: https://trimtailor.com/privacy-policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the trimtailor-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → TrimTailor Widget.
  4. Enter your TrimTailor Company ID.
  5. Save your changes. The widget script will now load on all public pages.
sections.faq:
Where can I find my Company ID?

Inside TrimTailor under /settings/widget.

Can I change widget colors or services inside WordPress?

No. All customization such as services, colors and texts is done inside the TrimTailor software.

Will the widget appear on every page?

Yes, as long as a valid Company ID is entered, the widget script will load on all public pages.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Switched to using wp_enqueue_script() to load the widget script instead of outputting a raw <script> tag.
  • Documented use of the external TrimTailor service, including what data is sent and links to the service terms and privacy policy.
  • Added an explicit License section to make the GPLv2-or-later license clear in the readme.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
